# Gmail Account Sort
**An LSPosed module that sorts Gmail accounts alphabetically (A–Z) by email address in the account switcher.**

## Installation

1. Install the APK from Releases.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed Manager.
3. Select Gmail as the target application.
4. Force stop Gmail and reopen it.

## Compatibility

- Gmail "2026.11.02.1015914183.Release" and later.
- Supports classic and Bento account switcher layouts.

Compatibility with future Gmail updates is not guaranteed.

## Source Code

[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tizianoluziramos/lsposedgmailaccountsort)

# Gmail 帐户排序
**LSPod 模块，可在帐户切换器中按电子邮件地址按字母顺序 (A-Z) 对 Gmail 帐户进行排序。**

## 安装

1. 从发行版安装 APK。
2. 在 LSPod Manager 中启用该模块。
3. 选择 Gmail 作为目标应用程序。
4. 强制停止 Gmail 并重新打开它。

## 兼容性

- Gmail“2026.11.02.1015914183.Release”及更高版本。
- 支持经典和 Bento 帐户切换器布局。

不保证与未来 Gmail 更新的兼容性。

## 源代码

[GitHub 存储库](https://github.com/tizianoluziramos/lsposedgmailaccountsort)
